name: @hadoku/service-kernel
description: The server parts any game keeps: edge auth and the tier gate, base path and bundle check, health and the busy probe, lifecycle, the JSON logger, the state directory, telemetry and capacity, per-caller limits, the browser relays, the erase registry, and createGameServer, which boots a game from its config and plugins. Knows no game; the app binds its service id, prefix and env names. MIT; imports only node built-ins, express, socket.io and @wolffm/*.
